description_i18n.zh-CN: 我要做软件 — 零基础小白的开箱即用开发助手：需求梳理、方案挑选、环境装配、引导式开发、验收测试、三级上线（本机/局域网/公网）、自动存档。入口：/start /continue /status /help
description_i18n.en: Make My App — walks absolute beginners from idea to a running app: requirements, solution picking, environment setup, guided coding, acceptance testing, 3-level deployment, and auto save-points.
